description: This Java source file implements a final class 'CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' that extends an abstract builder to create responses and events for a 'CreateThingLiveCommand' in the context of Eclipse Ditto's messaging system. It provides a fluent API for building command responses and events related to creating 'things' within the system, including handling conflict errors.
